title: Dual Fourier granularity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, let $f:V\to\bbr$, and let $\epsilon\in\bbr$. The dual Fourier coefficients of $f$ are granular at scale $\epsilon$ if every such coefficient is an integer multiple of $\epsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-vector space
